constraints_and_unknowns: No raw HTML, CSS, or media bytes have been successfully saved locally; readable replay observations are not a site backup.
The archive-wide URL index has not been obtained; this is not a complete crawl.
Two readable blog listing pages show 40 entries; this is not a count of all site posts or individually recovered articles.
Only one individual blog article is confirmed in the page inventory.
Original stylesheets, logo, font declarations, and rendered desktop/mobile layout remain unverified.
Shop and the third pagination replay contain historical error pages. Other captures may contain valid content.
A capture date is distinct from a post publication date. A replay may redirect to another capture.
Video embed IDs were identified, but playable video files and current playback were not verified.
Historical contact details, merchandise availability, and show dates must not be presented as current.
A target GitHub repository has not been supplied. A connected-repository search for bluescholars returned no matches.
A public restoration should preserve credits and only republish material the site operator is authorized to publish.
goal: Recreate as much of bluescholars.com as possible as a self-contained static website hosted on GitHub Pages.
user_authorized_scope: Use the May 29, 2021 homepage as reference and investigate other archive dates and linked pages/images to fill gaps.
